needed.evidence: sidewalk is under 1m wide and partly blocked by obstacles
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the right-side footway to a continuous and usable sidewalk of at least 1m width without obstructions

needed.evidence: footway partly blocked by parked vehicles
needed.suggestion: Implement appropriate parking regulations and install clear fences/bollards to prevent parking on the footway

needed.evidence: uneven sections on the narrow footway

needed.evidence: uneven surfaces and clutter in the narrow footway

needed.evidence: lack of safe crossing points for pedestrians
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised crossing with refuge on the wider road to provide a safe crossing facility for pedestrians

needed.evidence: present markings are largely ignored, leading to risky pedestrian crossings
needed.suggestion: Implement signalised crossings with adequate pedestrian refuge to ensure compliance and safety

needed.evidence: dropped kerbs are absent at pedestrian crossings
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at all pedestrian crossings to facilitate safe transitions for people with disabilities and other pedestrians
